text:
Sara (CEO): Short weekly exec note — a few operational items and asks.
Sara (CEO): A: EU private GA is targeted for Wed 07:00 UTC. Legal/OPS please confirm final DPA + compliance checklist by EOD Mon.
Sara (CEO): B: We're piloting an automated cost throttle for experimental models (soft throttle at tokens/min). Finance/Product: run impact sims and recommend thresholds.
Sara (CEO): C: SLA update proposal: move hosted uptime SLA to 99.7% with clearer L1 credit terms. Lina to draft legal wording and customer-facing FAQ.
Sara (CEO): Incident recap: Wed 03:40 UTC storage IO storm led to ~25m of elevated p99 and ~2% error spikes for a subset of tenants; fallback to CPU-backed replicas happened automatically. Postmortem will be posted tomorrow.
Sara (CEO): Metrics snapshot: hosted p95 = 130ms, p99 = 420ms (affected by IO), errors = 0.95% (above target). Dedicated steady.
Sara (CEO): Asks: 1) Comms: one-paragraph customer note + internal FAQ by Tue 11:00. 2) Eng: freeze non-critical console UX changes until EU GA completes. 3) SRE: finalize runbook for storage failover and share link.

Marcus (VP Eng): Ack. We'll hold console PRs and prioritize the IO mitigation: rolling block device firmware update + tuning. Tests scheduled Mon 02:00 UTC.
Marcus (VP Eng): Quick command we used for the workaround:
```
sudo systemctl stop infer-storage
./storage-repair --fast-rebuild --shard=7
sudo systemctl start infer-storage
```

Ajay (VP Product): On the cost throttle pilot: I'll export recent 14d token traces and propose thresholds per-model by Tue EOD. Also will flag any UX flows that need notice.

Lina (Head Legal): I'll draft SLA wording and short FAQ. Note: need to consult enterprise contracts team for Dedicated customers before final text.

Omar (SRE): Incident preliminary: root cause = overwhelmed NVMe queue on a host group; auto-failover logic worked, but rehydration contributed to tail. Mitigation applied: bump queue depth and add preemptive replica spin-up. Full writeup tomorrow.
Omar (SRE): Commands applied during mitigation:
```
echo 512 > /sys/block/nvme0/queue/nr_requests
kubectl scale deployment infer-replica --replicas=3
```

Kevin (Finance): I'll run the cost-sim with three throttle tiers and share revenue/ops impact. Need model list and 7/14d burst profiles from Prod. @Ajay please share.

Tess (Head of Sales): Sales + CS want the customer note as soon as possible; also preparing a one-pager for top accounts explaining EU GA and SLA changes. Will coordinate with Clara.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled for `private-eu-ga` (commit 9f3e2a) by @Marcus  ETA 42m.

Sara (CEO): Thanks all. I'll include a two-bullet summary in Monday all-hands. Ping me directly if legal sign-off slips or if the storage tests fail. :memo:
